whatsNew: The back arrow at the top of a screen works again on iOS 26. Before this fix it could stop responding, and the only way out was to close the app. The Equip screen has a new board laid out like a body, with a slot for your legs that looks like one. Tap a slot to see the gear you can wear there, with every stat named. A team's creator can now start Warpath fights from the first day, and you can send friend requests from player search. Ranks now show correctly on the leaderboard. The weekly Skirmish runs again: teams are matched every Monday, and your leader can pick the battleground during the first 48 hours. Two-handed weapons are stronger, and the game now warns you before one takes off your sword and shield. The Amulet Slot and most Treasure Trails cost less. Buying gear with coins is safer on a weak connection. The text across the app is clearer about what each reward, battle and team bonus does for you.
note: 1.1.2 replaces 1.1.1 in review (Kyle's yes, 2026-11-26): it holds the back arrow fix plus the Arena, Equip and Shop audit (qualia-fitness PRs 13 to 20). Kyle checked both builds on his phone.
